arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا
transliteration: Hal ataa 'alal insaani heenum minad dahri lam yakun shai'am mazkooraa

translations.en.sahih: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
translations.en.pickthall: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?
translations.en.yusufali: Has there not been over Man a long period of Time, when he was nothing - (not even) mentioned?
translations.id.indonesian: Bukankah telah datang atas manusia satu waktu dari masa, sedang dia ketika itu belum merupakan sesuatu yang dapat disebut?

arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
transliteration: Innaa khalaqnal insaana min nutfatin amshaajin nabta leehi faja'alnaahu samee'am baseeraa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily We created Man from a drop of mingled sperm, in order to try him: So We gave him (the gifts), of Hearing and Sight.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan manusia dari setetes mani yang bercampur yang Kami hendak mengujinya (dengan perintah dan larangan), karena itu Kami jadikan dia mendengar dan melihat.

arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
transliteration: Innaa hadainaahus sabeela immaa shaakiranw wa immaa kafoora

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving.
translations.en.yusufali: We showed him the Way: whether he be grateful or ungrateful (rests on his will).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menunjukinya jalan yang lurus; ada yang bersyukur dan ada pula yang kafir.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا
transliteration: Innaaa a'tadnaa lilkaa fireena salaasila wa aghlaalanw wa sa'eeraa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire.
translations.en.yusufali: For the Rejecters we have prepared chains, yokes, and a blazing Fire.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami menyediakan bagi orang-orang kafir rantai, belenggu dan neraka yang menyala-nyala.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
transliteration: innal abraara yashra boona min kaasin kaana mizaa juhaa kaafooraa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur,
translations.en.yusufali: As to the Righteous, they shall drink of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Kafur,-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang berbuat kebajikan minum dari gelas (berisi minuman) yang campurannya adalah air kafur,

arabic: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا
transliteration: 'Aynany yashrabu bihaa 'ibaadul laahi yafajjiroonahaa tafjeeraa

translations.en.sahih: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
translations.en.pickthall: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly,
translations.en.yusufali: A Fountain where the Devotees of Allah do drink, making it flow in unstinted abundance.
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) mata air (dalam surga) yang daripadanya hamba-hamba Allah minum, yang mereka dapat mengalirkannya dengan sebaik-baiknya.

arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا
transliteration: Yoofoona binnazri wa yakhaafoona yawman kaana sharruhoo mustateeraa

translations.en.sahih: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
translations.en.pickthall: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading,
translations.en.yusufali: They perform (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil flies far and wide.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka menunaikan nazar dan takut akan suatu hari yang azabnya merata di mana-mana.

arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا
transliteration: Wa yut''imoonat ta'aama 'alaa hubbihee miskeenanw wa yatemanw wa aseeraa

translations.en.sahih: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
translations.en.pickthall: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him,
translations.en.yusufali: And they feed, for the love of Allah, the indigent, the orphan, and the captive,-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka memberikan makanan yang disukainya kepada orang miskin, anak yatim dan orang yang ditawan.

arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا
transliteration: Innaamaa nut'imukum li wajhil laahi laa nureedu minkum jazaaa'anw wa laa shukooraa

translations.en.sahih: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
translations.en.pickthall: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you;
translations.en.yusufali: (Saying),"We feed you for the sake of Allah alone: no reward do we desire from you, nor thanks.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya kami memberi makanan kepadamu hanyalah untuk mengharapkan keridhaan Allah, kami tidak menghendaki balasan dari kamu dan tidak pula (ucapan) terima kasih.

arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا
transliteration: Innaa nakhaafu mir Rabbinna Yawman 'aboosan qamtareeraa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate.
translations.en.yusufali: "We only fear a Day of distressful Wrath from the side of our Lord."
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya kami takut akan (azab) Tuhan kami pada suatu hari yang (di hari itu) orang-orang bermuka masam penuh kesulitan.

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا
transliteration: Fa waqaahumul laahu sharra zaalikal yawmi wa laqqaahum nadratanw wa surooraa

translations.en.sahih: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
translations.en.pickthall: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;
translations.en.yusufali: But Allah will deliver them from the evil of that Day, and will shed over them a Light of Beauty and (blissful) Joy.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Tuhan memelihara mereka dari kesusahan hari itu, dan memberikan kepada mereka kejernihan (wajah) dan kegembiraan hati.

arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًۭا
transliteration: Wa jazaahum bimaa sabaroo janatanw wa hareeraa

translations.en.sahih: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
translations.en.pickthall: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire;
translations.en.yusufali: And because they were patient and constant, He will reward them with a Garden and (garments of) silk.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Dia memberi balasan kepada mereka karena kesabaran mereka (dengan) surga dan (pakaian) sutera,

arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا
transliteration: muttaki'eena feeha 'alal araaa 'iki laa yarawna feehaa shamsanw wa laa zamhareeraa

translations.en.sahih: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
translations.en.pickthall: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold.
translations.en.yusufali: Reclining in the (Garden) on raised thrones, they will see there neither the sun's (excessive heat) nor (the moon's) excessive cold.
translations.id.indonesian: di dalamnya mereka duduk bertelakan di atas dipan, mereka tidak merasakan di dalamnya (teriknya) matahari dan tidak pula dingin yang bersangatan.

arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا
transliteration: Wa daaniyatan 'alaihim zilaaluhaa wa zullilat qutoofu haa tazleela

translations.en.sahih: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
translations.en.pickthall: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down.
translations.en.yusufali: And the shades of the (Garden) will come low over them, and the bunches (of fruit), there, will hang low in humility.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan naungan (pohon-pohon surga itu) dekat di atas mereka dan buahnya dimudahkan memetiknya semudah-mudahnya.

arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
transliteration: Wa yutaafu 'alaihim bi aaniyatim min fiddatinw wa akwaabin kaanat qawaareeraa

translations.en.sahih: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
translations.en.pickthall: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass
translations.en.yusufali: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and goblets of crystal,-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan diedarkan kepada mereka bejana-bejana dari perak dan piala-piala yang bening laksana kaca,

arabic: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا
transliteration: Qawaareera min fiddatin qaddaroohaa taqdeeraa

translations.en.sahih: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
translations.en.pickthall: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds).
translations.en.yusufali: Crystal-clear, made of silver: they will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes).
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) kaca-kaca (yang terbuat) dari perak yang telah diukur mereka dengan sebaik-baiknya.

arabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
transliteration: Wa yusawna feehaa kaasan kaana mizaajuhaa zanjabeelaa

translations.en.sahih: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
translations.en.pickthall: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,
translations.en.yusufali: And they will be given to drink there of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Zanjabil,-
translations.id.indonesian: Di dalam surga itu mereka diberi minum segelas (minuman) yang campurannya adalah jahe.

arabic: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا
transliteration: 'Aynan feeha tusammaa salsabeelaa

translations.en.sahih: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.
translations.en.pickthall: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil.
translations.en.yusufali: A fountain there, called Salsabil.
translations.id.indonesian: (Yang didatangkan dari) sebuah mata air surga yang dinamakan salsabil.

arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا
transliteration: Wa yatoofu 'alaihim wildaanum mukhalladoona izaa ra aytahum hasibtahum lu'lu 'am mansoora

translations.en.sahih: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
translations.en.pickthall: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.
translations.en.yusufali: And round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness): If thou seest them, thou wouldst think them scattered Pearls.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka dikelilingi oleh pelayan-pelayan muda yang tetap muda. Apabila kamu melihat mereka, kamu akan mengira mereka, mutiara yang bertaburan.

arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا
transliteration: Wa izaa ra ayta summa ra ayta na'eemanw wa mulkan kabeera

translations.en.sahih: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
translations.en.pickthall: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.
translations.en.yusufali: And when thou lookest, it is there thou wilt see a Bliss and a Realm Magnificent.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apabila kamu melihat di sana (surga), niscaya kamu akan melihat berbagai macam kenikmatan dan kerajaan yang besar.

arabic: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا
transliteration: 'Aaliyahum siyaabu sundusin khudrunw wa istabraq, wa hullooo asaawira min fiddatinw wa saqaahum Rabbuhum sharaaban tahooraa

translations.en.sahih: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
translations.en.pickthall: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink.
translations.en.yusufali: Upon them will be green Garments of fine silk and heavy brocade, and they will be adorned with Bracelets of silver; and their Lord will give to them to drink of a Wine Pure and Holy.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka memakai pakaian sutera halus yang hijau dan sutera tebal dan dipakaikan kepada mereka gelang terbuat dari perak, dan Tuhan memberikan kepada mereka minuman yang bersih.

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
transliteration: Innaa haazaa kaana lakum jazz 'anw wa kaana sa'yukum mashkooraa

translations.en.sahih: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
translations.en.pickthall: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance.
translations.en.yusufali: "Verily this is a Reward for you, and your Endeavour is accepted and recognised."
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya ini adalah balasan untukmu, dan usahamu adalah disyukuri (diberi balasan).

arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا
transliteration: Innaa nahnu nazzalnaa 'alaikal quraana tanzeelaa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation;
translations.en.yusufali: It is We Who have sent down the Qur'an to thee by stages.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menurunkan Al Quran kepadamu (hai Muhammad) dengan berangsur-angsur.

arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
transliteration: Fasbir lihukmi Rabbika wa laa tuti' minhum aasiman aw kafooraa

translations.en.sahih: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
translations.en.pickthall: So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever.
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore be patient with constancy to the Command of thy Lord, and hearken not to the sinner or the ingrate among them.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka bersabarlah kamu untuk (melaksanakan) ketetapan Tuhanmu, dan janganlah kamu ikuti orang yang berdosa dan orang yang kafir di antar mereka.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا
transliteration: Wazkuris ma Rabbika bukratanw wa aseelaa

translations.en.sahih: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
translations.en.pickthall: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.
translations.en.yusufali: And celebrate the name of thy Lord morning and evening,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sebutlah nama Tuhanmu pada (waktu) pagi dan petang.

arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا
transliteration: Wa minal laili fasjud lahoo wa sabbihhu lailan taweelaa

translations.en.sahih: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.
translations.en.pickthall: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night.
translations.en.yusufali: And part of the night, prostrate thyself to Him; and glorify Him a long night through.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan pada sebagian dari malam, maka sujudlah kepada-Nya dan bertasbihlah kepada-Nya pada bagian yang panjang dimalam hari.

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا
transliteration: Inna haaa'ulaa'i yuhibboona 'aajilata wa yazaroona waraaa'ahum yawman saqeelaa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day.
translations.en.yusufali: As to these, they love the fleeting life, and put away behind them a Day (that will be) hard.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya mereka (orang kafir) menyukai kehidupan dunia dan mereka tidak memperdulikan kesudahan mereka, pada hari yang berat (hari akhirat).

arabic: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
transliteration: Nahnu khalaqnaahum wa shadadnaaa asrahum wa izaa shi'naa baddalnaaa amsaala hum tabdeelaa

translations.en.sahih: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
translations.en.pickthall: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead.
translations.en.yusufali: It is We Who created them, and We have made their joints strong; but, when We will, We can substitute the like of them by a complete change.
translations.id.indonesian: Kami telah menciptakan mereka dan menguatkan persendian tubuh mereka, apabila Kami menghendaki, Kami sungguh-sungguh mengganti (mereka) dengan orang-orang yang serupa dengan mereka.

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
transliteration: Inna haazihee tazkiratun fa man shaaa'at takhaza ilaa rabbihee sabeela

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord.
translations.en.yusufali: This is an admonition: Whosoever will, let him take a (straight) Path to his Lord.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya (ayat-ayat) ini adalah suatu peringatan, maka barangsiapa menghendaki (kebaikan bagi dirinya) niscaya dia mengambil jalan kepada Tuhannya.

arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
transliteration: Wa maa tashaaa'oona illaa anyyashaaa'al laah; innal laahaa kaana'Aleeman Hakeema

translations.en.sahih: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
translations.en.pickthall: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.
translations.en.yusufali: But ye will not, except as Allah wills; for Allah is full of Knowledge and Wisdom.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kamu tidak mampu (menempuh jalan itu), kecuali bila dikehendaki Allah. Sesungguhnya Allah adalah Maha Mengetahui lagi Maha Bijaksana.

arabic: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
transliteration: Yudkhilu mai yashaaa'u fee rahmatih; wazzaalimeena a'adda lahum 'azaaban aleemaa

translations.en.sahih: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
translations.en.pickthall: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom.
translations.en.yusufali: He will admit to His Mercy whom He will; But the wrong-doers,- for them has He prepared a grievous Penalty.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan memasukkan siapa yang dikehendaki-Nya ke dalam rahmat-Nya (surga). Dan bagi orang-orang zalim disediakan-Nya azab yang pedih.
